desc:
• BAKING MIX: Make a gingerbread cake or cookies the whole family will love

  • QUICK AND EASY: Enjoy cake or cookies in a few simple steps

  • ENDLESS OPTIONS: Prepare as gingerbread cake mix or cookie mix

  • GINGERBREAD GOODNESS: Bite into soft and chewy gingerbread cookies or moist gingerbread cake

  • CONTAINS: 14.5 oz (Pack of 12)
features:
Features

Dual-Use Mix
Prepare as a moist gingerbread cake or roll into soft, chewy gingerbread cookies.

Easy Prep for Both Options
Cake: mix with water and egg, then bake. Cookies: combine with water and butter for a quick dough.

Warm Molasses & Spice Flavor
Enriched flour, molasses powder, and classic spices deliver a comforting gingerbread taste.

Single 14.5 oz Bag
Makes enough for one cake or approximately two dozen cozy cookies.

Naturally Flavored
No artificial flavors, just genuine gingerbread goodness.

Allergy-Conscious Profile
Contains wheat and soy; may include traces of milk.

Benefits

Flexible Baking Solution
Enjoy versatility—switch between cake and cookies depending on your craving or occasion.

Quick & Convenient
Skip from mix to dessert in under an hour with minimal prep required.

Homey Aroma
Fills your kitchen with nostalgic gingerbread scents, perfect for seasonal baking or everyday comfort.

Kid-Friendly Activity
Rolling and baking cookies is a fun, hands-on project great for family time or classroom treats.

Consistent, Reliable Results
Easy-to-follow instructions ensure a dependable bake every time, ideal for both beginners and seasoned bakers.

Value for Size
One bag creates a satisfying batch, whether sweet cake or festive cookie, making it budget- and pantry-friendly.

Supports Education
Participates in Box Tops for Education, so your purchase helps local schools.
ingredients: Enriched Flour Bleached (wheat flour, niacin, iron, thiamin mononitrate, riboflavin, folic acid), Sugar, Palm Oil, Dried Molasses, Leavening (baking soda, sodium acid pyrophosphate), Corn Starch, Salt, Natural Flavor.
